feedback.end: Swans usually lay 12 eggs. They are a blue-grey colour and are the size of an adult human’s hand!
Baby swans are called cygnets. They are small and have grey-brown, fluffy feathers.
Juvenile swans are in between being babies and adults. As they get older, they begin to lose their grey feathers, and white feathers grow in their place. This can take 2-3 years.
This is an adult swan. At about 3 or 4 years old, swans are considered to be adults. An interesting fact about swans is that they mate for life, which is different from a lot of other animals.
